messages.author: 166e40180306ffff
messages.subject: R crashes withf facet_wrap
parts:
Hi

Whenever I specifiy ncol=1 in the facet_wrap function, R crashes. I
experienced the problem on two different computers. Try this example.
library(ggplot2)
p <- qplot(price, data = diamonds, geom = "histogram", binwidth =
1000)
p + facet_wrap(~ color,ncol=1)

I hope Hadley can solve this issue in the next release.

Best regards,
Erich

messages.subject: Re: R crashes withf facet_wrap
parts:
Hi guys,

That's a known bug (in R!) which is fixed in R 2.9 and worked around
in the next version of ggplot2. I've just sent the book away for copy
editing, so I'm hoping I'll be able to release a new version of the
package very soon.

Regards,

Hadley
